body:
I think we need to check that both types are arrays or both are dictionaries. Otherwise, the following code will be marked as unsafe:

```gdscript
func split_to_strings(string: String) -> Array[String]:
    var result: PackedStringArray = string.split(",")
    return result
```

Currently, it causes a runtime error, but doesn't produce a compile-time error. This is a bug, this code should work without errors at runtime. I've opened a PR to fix it:

* #115386

You're right, I didn't know about packed arrays. I pushed a fix, hope it's good now.

Also, I lifted this logic from `reduce_assignment`, and that seems to have the same problem. For example, the assignment on the last line gets marked as unsafe:

```gdscript
var result: PackedStringArray = string.split(",")
var typed_array: Array[String]
typed_array = result
```

Your PR doesn't seem to address assignments, so I'm not sure if this behaviour is intended or not.
